name: Unitree Dex5-1
summary: Five-finger dexterous hand, 20 DoF (16 active), with 94 tactile sensors.
body: Unitree lists 20 degrees of freedom (16 active + 4), 1100 g, a 3.5 kg palm-down / 4.5 kg palm-left load on a 5 cm round object, 10 N fingertip force and 94 pressure sensors in 12 arrays ([unitree.com/Dex5-1](https://www.unitree.com/Dex5-1)). Unitree's page doesn't list compatible robots or a price.
